name: Missing required env

blockers.description: config.py reads os.environ["SMTP_HOST"] with no default, but SMTP_HOST is not documented in README.md, .env.example, or any deployment config.

acceptable_extra_findings.note: Observation that CI happens to inject SMTP_HOST itself, masking the gap, is acceptable supporting context.

forbidden_findings.note: SMTP_PORT, LOG_LEVEL, and API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS are documented, but SMTP_HOST is required and undocumented; claiming configuration is fully documented is false.
SMTP_PORT, LOG_LEVEL, and API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS are all correctly documented in README.md and .env.example; only SMTP_HOST is the gap.

notes: Development case. Contrast is deliberate: three vars are documented correctly, one required var is silently missing from every doc surface.
